mapper.sql:
with CET as( SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, C.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, A.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID parentCustomerId, A.PFLSH PFLSH, y.item_value creditQuoteTypeValue, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE creditQuoteTypeCode, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE creditQuoteType, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, B.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK creditQuoteRank, nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedAmt, nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)/100000000 as usedEnstustAmt, decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0))/100000000 as usedAmtTotal, (nvl(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)-decode(nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0),0,0,nvl(D.TRADE_AMT,0)+ nvl(E.TRADE_AMT,0)))/100000000 as remainAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_MST_INFO B on A.CREDIT_MST_ID=B.SEQNO and B.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE in ('01','04') left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO C on A.CUSTOMER_ID=C.CUSTOMER_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and B.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_DEAL GROUP BY SEQNO) D on A.SEQNO=D.SEQNO left join (select sum(TRADE_AMT) as TRADE_AMT,SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION GROUP BY SEQNO) E on A.SEQNO=E.SEQNO
A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY vdate desc )

mapper.sql:
with CET as( SELECT
case when NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedEnstustAmt,E.usedEnstustAmt),0) < 0 then 0 else NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedEnstustAmt,E.usedEnstustAmt),0) end AS usedEnstustAmt ,
case when NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmt,E.usedAmt),0) < 0 then 0 else NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmt,E.usedAmt),0) end AS usedAmt ,
case when NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmtTotal,E.usedAmtTotal),0) < 0 then 0 else NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmtTotal,E.usedAmtTotal),0) end AS usedAmtTotal,
(NVL(A.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000) AS creditAmt ,
G.creditAmtNl AS creditAmtNl ,
case when G.usedEnstustAmt < 0 then 0 else G.usedEnstustAmt end AS usedEnstustAmtNl,
case when G.usedAmt < 0 then 0 else G.usedAmt end AS usedAmtNl,
case when G.usedAmtTotal < 0 then 0 else G.usedAmtTotal end AS usedAmtTotalNl,
CASE WHEN (A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 - NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmtTotal,E.usedAmtTotal ),0)) < 0 THEN 0 WHEN (A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 - NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmtTotal,E.usedAmtTotal ),0)) >= A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 THEN A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 ELSE (A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 - NVL(DECODE(A.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',D.usedAmtTotal,E.usedAmtTotal ),0)) END AS remainAmt,
CASE WHEN G.creditAmtNl - G.usedAmtTotal < 0 THEN 0 WHEN G.creditAmtNl - G.usedAmtTotal >= G.creditAmtNl THEN G.creditAmtNl ELSE G.creditAmtNl - G.usedAmtTotal END AS remainAmtNl, C.CREDIT_TYPE AS creditType, C.CREDIT_TAG_NAME AS creditQuoteTypeValue, A.SEQNO AS SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID AS creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID AS customerId, F.CUSTOMER_NAME AS customerName, A.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID AS parentCustomerId, A.PFLSH AS PFLSH, A.VDATE AS VDATE, A.MDATE AS MDATE FROM CREDIT_LINES A LEFT JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO B ON A.CREDIT_MST_ID = B.CREDIT_MST_ID LEFT JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO C ON B.CREDIT_TAG_ID = C.CREDIT_TAG_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(DECODE(IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},NVL(amount,0),0)/100000000) AS usedEnstustAmt, SUM(DECODE(IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},0,NVL(amount,0))/100000000) AS usedAmt, SUM(NVL(amount,0)/100000000) AS usedAmtTotal FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER WHERE STATUS = '01'
AND CDATE <= to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) D ON D.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CREDIT_MST_ID, SUM(DECODE(IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},NVL(amount,0),0)/100000000) AS usedEnstustAmt, SUM(DECODE(IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},0,NVL(amount,0))/100000000) AS usedAmt, SUM(NVL(amount,0)/100000000) AS usedAmtTotal FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST WHERE STATUS = '01'
AND CDATE <= to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID,CREDIT_MST_ID ) E ON E.CUSTOMER_ID = A.CUSTOMER_ID AND E.CREDIT_MST_ID = A.CREDIT_MST_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO F ON A.CUSTOMER_ID=F.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.CUSTOMER_ID AS customerId, B.PFLSH AS PFLSH, B.VDATE AS vdate, SUM(DECODE(A.IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},NVL(A.AMOUNT,0),0)/100000000) AS usedEnstustAmt, SUM(DECODE(A.IS_BOTTOM,#{yes01},0,NVL(A.AMOUNT,0))/100000000) AS usedAmt, SUM(NVL(A.AMOUNT,0)/100000000) AS usedAmtTotal, MAX (B.CREDIT_AMT/100000000) AS creditAmtNl FROM CREDIT_LINES B INNER JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO C ON B.CREDIT_MST_ID = C.CREDIT_MST_ID INNER JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO D ON C.CREDIT_TAG_ID = D.CREDIT_TAG_ID AND D.CREDIT_TYPE = #{limitType13} LEFT JOIN CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST A ON A.CREDIT_LINES_ID = B.SEQNO AND A.CREDIT_MST_ID = B.CREDIT_MST_ID AND A.STATUS = '01'
AND A.CDATE <= to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY B.CUSTOMER_ID, B.PFLSH, B.VDATE ) G ON G.customerId = A.CUSTOMER_ID AND G.PFLSH = A.PFLSH AND G.vdate = A.VDATE AND A.CREDIT_MST_ID = '0001' WHERE A.CREDIT_TYPE = #{creditTypeOrg} AND A.SEQNO NOT IN ( SELECT A.SEQNO FROM CREDIT_LINES A INNER JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO B ON A.CREDIT_MST_ID = B.CREDIT_MST_ID INNER JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO C ON B.CREDIT_TAG_ID = C.CREDIT_TAG_ID AND C.CREDIT_TYPE = #{limitType13} )
AND A.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND A.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
AND to_char(A.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE}
AND #{vdate,jdbcType=DATE} < = to_char(A.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY A.SEQNO ,A.CUSTOMER_ID )

WITH CET AS( SELECT a.*, a.usedAmt+a.usedZizhuAmt+a.usedEnstustAmt usedAmtTotal, a.creditAmt-(a.usedAmt+a.usedZizhuAmt+a.usedEnstustAmt) remainAmt, a.usedEnstustAmtNl+a.usedZizhuAmtNl+a.usedAmtNl usedAmtTotalNl, a.creditAmtNl-(a.usedEnstustAmtNl+a.usedZizhuAmtNl+a.usedAmtNl) remainAmtNl FROM ( SELECT CREDIT_LINES.SEQNO seqno, CREDIT_LINES.PFLSH pflsh, CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, CREDIT_TAG_INFO.CREDIT_TAG_NAME creditQuoteTypeValue, CREDIT_LINES.PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID parentCustomerId, CREDIT_LINES.VDATE vdate, CREDIT_LINES.MDATE mdate, CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, table1.creditAmt creditAmtNl, CASE WHEN NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table2.amountSum,table3.amountSum),0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table2.amountSum,table3.amountSum),0) END AS usedAmt, CASE WHEN NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table5.amountSum,table7.amountSum),0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table5.amountSum,table7.amountSum),0) END AS usedZizhuAmt, CASE WHEN NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table6.amountSum,table8.amountSum),0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(DECODE(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID,'0001',table6.amountSum,table8.amountSum),0) END AS usedEnstustAmt, CASE WHEN NVL(table4.amountSum,0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(table4.amountSum,0) END AS usedAmtNl, CASE WHEN NVL(table9.amountSum,0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(table9.amountSum,0) END AS usedZizhuAmtNl, CASE WHEN NVL(table10.amountSum,0)<0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(table10.amountSum,0) END AS usedEnstustAmtNl FROM CREDIT_LINES LEFT JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO ON CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID=CREDIT_CONF_INFO.CREDIT_MST_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO ON CREDIT_CONF_INFO.CREDIT_TAG_ID=CREDIT_TAG_INFO.CREDIT_TAG_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.SEQNO seqno, c1.PFLSH pflsh, c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, c1.VDATE vdate, c1.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES c1 INNER JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO c2 ON c1.CREDIT_MST_ID=c2.CREDIT_MST_ID INNER JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO c3 ON c2.CREDIT_TAG_ID=c3.CREDIT_TAG_ID WHERE c3.CREDIT_TYPE='13' AND c1.VDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) table1 ON CREDIT_LINES.PFLSH=table1.pflsh AND CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table1.customerId AND CREDIT_LINES.VDATE=table1.vdate LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='N' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID ) table2 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table2.customerId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='N' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table3 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table3.customerId AND CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID=table3.creditMstId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='N' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table4 ON table1.customerId=table4.customerId AND table1.creditMstId=table4.creditMstId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE=( SELECT MAX(c1.CDATE) FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AND f2.TYPE_7='04' GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID ) table5 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table5.customerId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE=( SELECT MAX(c1.CDATE) FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AND f2.TYPE_7!='04' GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID ) table6 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table6.customerId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE=( SELECT MAX(c1.CDATE) FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AND f2.TYPE_7='04' GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table7 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table7.customerId AND CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID=table7.creditMstId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE=( SELECT MAX(c1.CDATE) FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AND f2.TYPE_7!='04' GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table8 ON CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID=table8.customerId AND CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_MST_ID=table8.creditMstId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table9 ON table1.customerId=table9.customerId AND table1.creditMstId=table9.creditMstId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c1.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, c1.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, SUM(c1.AMOUNT)/100000000 amountSum FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f1 ON c1.FINPROD_ID=f1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE f2 ON f1.P_FINPROD_ID=f2.FINPROD_ID WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.STATUS='01' AND c1.CDATE=( SELECT MAX(c1.CDATE) FROM CREDIT_USING_CUSTOMER_MST c1 WHERE c1.IS_BOTTOM='Y' AND c1.CDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AND f2.TYPE_7!='04' GROUP BY c1.CUSTOMER_ID,c1.CREDIT_MST_ID ) table10 ON table1.customerId=table10.customerId AND table1.creditMstId=table10.creditMstId WHERE CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_TYPE = '01' AND CREDIT_LINES.SEQNO NOT IN ( SELECT c1.SEQNO FROM CREDIT_LINES c1 INNER JOIN CREDIT_CONF_INFO c2 ON c1.CREDIT_MST_ID = c2.CREDIT_MST_ID INNER JOIN CREDIT_TAG_INFO c3 ON c2.CREDIT_TAG_ID = c3.CREDIT_TAG_ID AND c3.CREDIT_TYPE = '13' ) AND CREDIT_LINES.VDATE<=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND CREDIT_LINES.MDATE>=to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{item} )
AND CREDIT_LINES.PFLSH LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pflsh}),'%')
ORDER BY CREDIT_LINES.SEQNO,CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID ) a )

CREDIT_LINES.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, CREDIT_ASSETPOOL.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, CREDIT_LINES.VDATE VDATE, CREDIT_LINES.MDATE MDATE, nvl(CREDIT_LINES.CREDIT_AMT,0)/100000000 creditAmt, CASE WHEN
